FSSAI Basic Registration.shortDescription: Obtain FSSAI basic registration for small food businesses with simple documentation and quick turnaround.
FSSAI Basic Registration.longDescription: Basic registration applies to small food businesses below the prescribed turnover threshold. We manage application preparation and submission for quick approval.
benefits: Legal authorization for small food businesses

faqs.question: Who is eligible for basic registration?
faqs.answer: Food businesses with annual turnover up to ₹12 lakh.

faqs.question: How long is it valid?
faqs.answer: 1 to 5 years, as chosen at application.

faqs.question: What if turnover exceeds the limit later?
faqs.answer: You must upgrade to a state or central license.

FSSAI State License.shortDescription: Obtain state FSSAI license for medium-scale food businesses with complete documentation support.
FSSAI State License.longDescription: State license applies to medium-sized food businesses. We manage eligibility assessment, documentation, and application filing through approval.

process.title: Eligibility Assessment
process.description: Confirm turnover and category for state license.

faqs.question: Who needs a state license?
faqs.answer: Food businesses with turnover between ₹12 lakh and ₹20 crore.

faqs.question: Is inspection always required?
faqs.answer: Often yes, depending on the food category and premises.

faqs.question: How long is the license valid?
faqs.answer: 1 to 5 years, chosen at the time of application.

FSSAI Central License.shortDescription: Obtain central FSSAI license for large or specialized food businesses with complete compliance support.
FSSAI Central License.longDescription: Central license applies to large-scale operations, importers, and specific specialized categories. We manage documentation, filing, and approval coordination.
benefits: Builds credibility for major business relationships

faqs.question: Who needs a central license?
faqs.answer: Businesses with turnover above ₹20 crore, importers, and certain specified categories.

faqs.question: Is central license required for e-commerce?
faqs.answer: Large e-commerce food operators typically require central licensing.

faqs.question: How long does approval take?
faqs.answer: Typically 20-40 days depending on category and documentation.

FSSAI License Renewal.shortDescription: Timely FSSAI license renewal to maintain uninterrupted food business compliance.
FSSAI License Renewal.longDescription: We track your license expiry and manage renewal application filing well ahead of the deadline to avoid lapse in your food business authorization.
benefits: Avoids lapse in food business authorization

faqs.question: When should renewal be filed?
faqs.answer: At least 30 days before expiry, as per FSSAI norms.

faqs.question: What if the license lapses?
faqs.answer: Operating without a valid license attracts penalty and legal risk.

faqs.question: Can the validity period be changed at renewal?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can choose a new validity period from 1 to 5 years.

FSSAI License Modification.shortDescription: Update your FSSAI license details following changes in business address, category, or ownership.
FSSAI License Modification.longDescription: Changes in business particulars require an FSSAI modification application. We manage document preparation and filing for accurate, updated records.

faqs.question: What changes require modification?
faqs.answer: Address, category, business name, or ownership changes, among others.

faqs.question: Is a fee applicable for modification?
faqs.answer: Yes, a nominal government fee applies based on the change type.

faqs.question: Can modification be combined with renewal?
faqs.answer: In some cases, yes, if timed appropriately.

FSSAI License Transfer.shortDescription: Manage the transfer of FSSAI license or registration in cases of ownership or business change.
FSSAI License Transfer.longDescription: In the event of business transfer or ownership change, we manage the FSSAI transfer process, ensuring continuity of legal food business operations.
benefits: Smooth continuity of food business operations
Clear updated records for new owner

process.title: Approval
process.description: Receive updated license for the new owner.

faqs.question: Can FSSAI license be directly transferred?
faqs.answer: In most cases, a fresh application is needed for the new entity, following surrender by the previous holder.

faqs.question: Is there downtime during transfer?
faqs.answer: Proper planning minimizes any compliance gap.

faqs.question: What documents does the new owner need?
faqs.answer: Standard registration documents plus transfer/sale agreement.

FSSAI License Surrender.shortDescription: Surrender your FSSAI license or registration when closing or discontinuing food business operations.
FSSAI License Surrender.longDescription: When a food business closes, the FSSAI license should be formally surrendered. We manage the application and confirm proper closure of compliance obligations.

faqs.question: Is surrender mandatory on closure?
faqs.answer: Yes, to formally end compliance obligations and avoid penalties.

faqs.question: Can a surrendered license be reactivated?
faqs.answer: No, a fresh application would be required to resume operations.

faqs.question: Are pending returns required before surrender?
faqs.answer: Yes, all applicable compliance should be up to date first.

FSSAI Food Product Approval.shortDescription: Obtain product approval for novel or specialized food products requiring FSSAI clearance.
FSSAI Food Product Approval.longDescription: Certain food products require specific FSSAI approval before market launch. We manage documentation, safety data compilation, and application filing.
benefits: Legal market clearance for specialized products

process.title: Requirement Assessment
process.description: Determine if product approval is needed.

faqs.question: Which products need approval?
faqs.answer: Novel foods, health supplements, and products outside standard categories.

faqs.question: Is testing mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, safety and composition testing supports the approval application.

faqs.question: Can approval be denied?
faqs.answer: Yes, if safety or compliance concerns aren't adequately addressed.

FSSAI Import License.shortDescription: Obtain the FSSAI license required to import food products into India compliantly.
FSSAI Import License.longDescription: Food importers require a central FSSAI license along with import-specific compliance. We manage documentation and application filing for smooth customs clearance.
benefits: Legal authorization to import food products

faqs.question: Is central license mandatory for food importers?
faqs.answer: Yes, all food importers require a central FSSAI license.

faqs.question: Is IEC required alongside FSSAI license?
faqs.answer: Yes, IEC is a separate mandatory requirement for import activities.

faqs.question: Does each consignment need separate approval?
faqs.answer: Import consignments are cleared through NOC at the port, not separately licensed.

FSSAI Export Compliance.shortDescription: Ensure FSSAI compliance for food exports including documentation and quality certification.
FSSAI Export Compliance.longDescription: Food exporters must meet FSSAI and destination-country requirements. We help with documentation, health certificates, and compliance coordination for exports.

faqs.question: Is FSSAI license required for exporters?
faqs.answer: Yes, a valid FSSAI license is mandatory for food exporters.

faqs.question: Do destination countries have separate requirements?
faqs.answer: Yes, additional certifications may be needed based on the importing country.

faqs.question: Who issues health certificates for exports?
faqs.answer: Authorized certification bodies recognized by FSSAI/APEDA as applicable.

FSSAI Registration for Restaurants.shortDescription: Get your restaurant registered or licensed with FSSAI based on scale of operations.
FSSAI Registration for Restaurants.longDescription: Restaurants must obtain FSSAI registration or license depending on turnover, along with health and hygiene compliance. We manage the complete process.

faqs.question: Do all restaurants need a license?
faqs.answer: Depends on turnover; smaller ones may only need basic registration.

faqs.question: Is hygiene rating separate from FSSAI license?
faqs.answer: Yes, hygiene rating is a voluntary additional assessment.

faqs.question: Is renewal required for restaurants?
faqs.answer: Yes, based on the validity period chosen.

FSSAI Registration for Manufacturers.shortDescription: Get FSSAI registration or license for food manufacturing units based on production scale.
FSSAI Registration for Manufacturers.longDescription: Manufacturing units need registration or licensing based on production capacity and turnover. We manage eligibility assessment and application filing.

faqs.question: Does production capacity affect license type?
faqs.answer: Yes, capacity and turnover determine state or central licensing needs.

faqs.question: Is water testing mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, for manufacturing units using water in production.

faqs.question: Is inspection always conducted?
faqs.answer: Generally yes, for manufacturing premises before license grant.

FSSAI Registration for Distributors.shortDescription: Get FSSAI registration or license for food distribution businesses based on scale of operations.
FSSAI Registration for Distributors.longDescription: Distributors handling food products need appropriate FSSAI compliance. We assess eligibility and manage application filing for smooth registration.
benefits: Builds trust with retailers and buyers

faqs.question: Do distributors need a separate license from manufacturers?
faqs.answer: Yes, each entity in the supply chain requires its own FSSAI compliance.

faqs.question: Is storage condition inspected?
faqs.answer: Yes, especially for licenses beyond basic registration.

faqs.question: Can one license cover multiple storage locations?
faqs.answer: No, each additional premises may require separate registration.

FSSAI Registration for Wholesalers.shortDescription: Obtain FSSAI compliance for wholesale food businesses handling bulk trade.
FSSAI Registration for Wholesalers.longDescription: Wholesale food traders need appropriate FSSAI registration or license based on turnover. We manage the complete application process.

faqs.question: What turnover requires a state license for wholesalers?
faqs.answer: Turnover between ₹12 lakh and ₹20 crore typically requires a state license.

faqs.question: Is warehouse hygiene assessed?
faqs.answer: Yes, storage conditions are reviewed during licensing.

faqs.question: Can wholesalers also need transporter compliance?
faqs.answer: Yes, if they operate their own transport fleet.

FSSAI Registration for Retailers.shortDescription: Get FSSAI registration or license for retail food businesses based on scale of sales.
FSSAI Registration for Retailers.longDescription: Retail food outlets require FSSAI compliance appropriate to their turnover. We manage eligibility assessment and complete application processing.
benefits: Legal authorization to sell food products
Builds consumer trust at point of sale
Quick, low-cost compliance for small retailers

faqs.question: Do small kirana stores need FSSAI registration?
faqs.answer: Yes, basic registration is required regardless of size.

faqs.question: Is display of the certificate mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, the certificate must be displayed prominently at the premises.

faqs.question: What if a retailer sells packaged and loose food?
faqs.answer: The same registration/license covers both, based on turnover.

FSSAI Registration for Cloud Kitchens.shortDescription: Get FSSAI registration or license tailored for delivery-only cloud kitchen operations.
FSSAI Registration for Cloud Kitchens.longDescription: Cloud kitchens have specific compliance considerations around hygiene and delivery packaging. We manage eligibility assessment and application filing.
features: Kitchen hygiene and packaging compliance guidance
benefits: Builds trust on food delivery platforms

faqs.question: Is FSSAI required before joining delivery apps?
faqs.answer: Yes, food delivery platforms mandate a valid FSSAI license/registration.

faqs.question: Can multiple brands operate from one cloud kitchen?
faqs.answer: Yes, but proper record-keeping and compliance for each brand is required.

faqs.question: Is packaging compliance checked?
faqs.answer: Yes, food-safe and properly labeled packaging is expected.

FSSAI Registration for Caterers.shortDescription: Get FSSAI registration or license for catering businesses covering events and bulk food service.
FSSAI Registration for Caterers.longDescription: Caterers serving events and bulk orders need appropriate FSSAI compliance. We manage eligibility assessment and application processing.

faqs.question: Do event caterers need a separate license per event?
faqs.answer: No, a single license covers ongoing catering operations.

faqs.question: Is transport of food regulated too?
faqs.answer: Yes, food must be transported hygienically as per FSSAI norms.

faqs.question: What turnover triggers a state license?
faqs.answer: Above ₹12 lakh annual turnover typically requires a state license.

FSSAI Registration for Home Food Busines.shortDescription: Get FSSAI registration for home-based food businesses selling homemade products.
FSSAI Registration for Home Food Busines.longDescription: Home-based food entrepreneurs need FSSAI compliance appropriate to their scale. We manage simple, quick registration for home kitchens.
benefits: Legal authorization for home-based food sales
Builds customer trust for small brands

process.title: Eligibility Check
process.description: Confirm registration category based on turnover.

faqs.question: Is FSSAI needed for selling on Instagram/WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Yes, any commercial food sale requires FSSAI compliance.

faqs.question: Do home businesses need premises inspection?
faqs.answer: Basic registration usually doesn't require formal inspection.

faqs.question: Can this scale up later to a full license?
faqs.answer: Yes, as turnover grows, you can upgrade to state/central licensing.

FSSAI Label Compliance.shortDescription: Ensure your food product labels meet FSSAI's mandatory labelling and declaration requirements.
FSSAI Label Compliance.longDescription: We review your product labels against FSSAI regulations covering mandatory declarations, nutritional information, and claims compliance.

faqs.question: What are mandatory label declarations?
faqs.answer: FSSAI license number, ingredients, net quantity, MRP, and manufacturing/expiry dates, among others.

faqs.question: Is nutritional information mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, for most packaged food products.

faqs.question: Can misleading health claims be penalized?
faqs.answer: Yes, unsubstantiated claims can attract regulatory action.

FSSAI Compliance Audit.shortDescription: Comprehensive review of your food business's FSSAI compliance across licensing, hygiene, and labelling.
FSSAI Compliance Audit.longDescription: We conduct a proactive compliance audit covering licensing status, hygiene practices, labelling, and documentation to identify gaps before inspection.

faqs.question: How often should this audit be done?
faqs.answer: Annually, or before major inspections/expansions.

faqs.question: Is this different from a government inspection?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is a proactive internal review, not a statutory requirement.

faqs.question: What does the report include?
faqs.answer: Identified gaps with prioritized corrective actions.

FSSAI Notice Reply.shortDescription: Professional preparation of responses to FSSAI notices regarding compliance or violations.
FSSAI Notice Reply.longDescription: FSSAI notices require careful, timely responses. We review the notice, gather supporting documentation, and draft a comprehensive reply.
benefits: Reduces risk of penalty or license suspension

process.title: Submission
process.description: File the reply within the deadline.

faqs.question: What triggers an FSSAI notice?
faqs.answer: Inspection findings, complaints, or documentation discrepancies.

faqs.question: What happens if ignored?
faqs.answer: It may lead to penalty, suspension, or cancellation of license.

faqs.question: Can a hearing be requested?
faqs.answer: Yes, in certain proceedings a personal hearing may be scheduled.

FSSAI Inspection Assistance.shortDescription: Prepare for and support your business through FSSAI premises inspections.
FSSAI Inspection Assistance.longDescription: We help you prepare documentation, hygiene practices, and compliance records ahead of scheduled or surprise FSSAI inspections.

faqs.question: Are FSSAI inspections announced in advance?
faqs.answer: Both scheduled and surprise inspections can occur.

faqs.question: What do inspectors typically check?
faqs.answer: Hygiene, storage, licensing display, and record-keeping.

faqs.question: What happens if violations are found?
faqs.answer: Notices, improvement directions, or penalties may follow depending on severity.

FSSAI Hygiene Compliance.shortDescription: Implement hygiene standards and practices required for FSSAI compliance across your food business.
FSSAI Hygiene Compliance.longDescription: We assess your premises and processes against FSSAI hygiene requirements, providing practical recommendations for compliant, consumer-safe operations.

faqs.question: What hygiene standards apply?
faqs.answer: FSSAI's Schedule 4 hygiene and sanitary requirements.

faqs.question: Is staff training required?
faqs.answer: Yes, food handlers should undergo basic hygiene training.

faqs.question: Does hygiene affect license renewal?
faqs.answer: Non-compliance can affect inspection outcomes and license standing.

FSSAI Food Safety Management.shortDescription: Implement a Food Safety Management System aligned with FSSAI and hazard-control requirements.
FSSAI Food Safety Management.longDescription: We help design and implement a Food Safety Management System covering hazard identification, control points, and documentation for consistent compliance.
features: Hazard identification and control point mapping

faqs.question: Is FSMS mandatory for all businesses?
faqs.answer: Larger and central-licensed businesses are generally expected to have one.

faqs.question: Is this the same as HACCP?
faqs.answer: FSMS often incorporates HACCP principles as part of the broader system.

faqs.question: Does FSMS require certification?
faqs.answer: Certification is optional but strengthens credibility and compliance.

FSSAI Annual Return Filing.shortDescription: Prepare and file mandatory annual returns for FSSAI license holders based on food category.
FSSAI Annual Return Filing.longDescription: License holders in specified categories must file annual returns (Form D1/D2). We compile production/sales data and ensure timely filing.

faqs.question: Who must file Form D1?
faqs.answer: Manufacturers, importers, and specified categories of licensees.

faqs.question: What is Form D2?
faqs.answer: A half-yearly return for milk and milk product units.

faqs.question: What is the due date for annual returns?
faqs.answer: Generally 31st May following the financial year.

FSSAI Food Business Compliance.shortDescription: Ongoing FSSAI compliance management covering licensing, filings, and regulatory updates.
FSSAI Food Business Compliance.longDescription: We provide holistic compliance management for food businesses, tracking licensing status, filing obligations, and regulatory changes throughout the year.
benefits: Single point of ongoing FSSAI compliance
Peace of mind for business owners

faqs.question: What does ongoing compliance cover?
faqs.answer: License renewal, annual returns, and regulatory update tracking.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for multi-location businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can be scaled for multiple premises and licenses.

faqs.question: How are regulatory updates communicated?
faqs.answer: Through periodic advisories relevant to your business category.

FSSAI E-Commerce Food Business.shortDescription: Ensure FSSAI compliance for online food businesses covering listing, packaging, and delivery requirements.
FSSAI E-Commerce Food Business.longDescription: E-commerce food businesses face specific compliance around packaging, labelling, and platform requirements. We manage licensing and compliance for online operations.
benefits: Legal authorization for online food sales

process.title: Category Assessment
process.description: Determine applicable license type for e-commerce.

process.title: Approval
process.description: Secure license and confirm platform compliance.

faqs.question: Do e-commerce food sellers need central license?
faqs.answer: Large-scale operations typically require central licensing.

faqs.question: Is separate approval needed for each platform?
faqs.answer: No, a single valid license covers listing across platforms.

faqs.question: Are cold-chain requirements different online?
faqs.answer: Yes, additional packaging and delivery-time compliance may apply for perishable items.

FSSAI Storage License Compliance.shortDescription: Ensure FSSAI compliance for cold storage and warehousing facilities handling food products.
FSSAI Storage License Compliance.longDescription: Storage facilities handling food require appropriate FSSAI licensing and temperature/hygiene compliance. We manage documentation and application filing.
benefits: Legal authorization for food storage operations
Builds trust with clients using your storage

faqs.question: Do cold storage units need FSSAI license?
faqs.answer: Yes, if handling food products, regardless of ownership of the goods.

faqs.question: Is temperature monitoring mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, for cold-chain compliance and food safety.

faqs.question: Can shared warehouses obtain a single license?
faqs.answer: Each operating entity typically requires its own license.

FSSAI Transporter Compliance.shortDescription: Ensure FSSAI compliance for food transportation vehicles and logistics operations.
FSSAI Transporter Compliance.longDescription: Food transporters must meet hygiene and vehicle standards under FSSAI rules. We manage registration and compliance guidance for transport operations.

process.title: Application/Guidance
process.description: File registration or provide compliance guidance.

faqs.question: Do all food transport vehicles need registration?
faqs.answer: Requirements vary; larger fleet operators generally need formal compliance.

faqs.question: What hygiene standards apply to vehicles?
faqs.answer: Clean, covered, and appropriately temperature-controlled transport conditions.

faqs.question: Is this relevant for delivery aggregators?
faqs.answer: Yes, particularly for temperature-sensitive food delivery.

FSSAI Product Addition.shortDescription: Add new food products or categories to your existing FSSAI license.
FSSAI Product Addition.longDescription: Expanding your product range often requires updating your FSSAI license with new categories. We manage the application for adding products smoothly.
benefits: Legal compliance for expanded product range
Avoids penalty for unlisted product sales

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit modification request for product addition.

process.title: Approval
process.description: Receive updated license with new categories.

faqs.question: Can I sell a new product before license update?
faqs.answer: No, the license should reflect all product categories being sold.

faqs.question: Does adding products change the license fee?
faqs.answer: It may, depending on the number of new categories added.

faqs.question: Is this different from a full license upgrade?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is a modification, not a change in license type.
